x-openregister.description: Demo data for humaniq. NOT installed automatically — a mock register is imported on demand, from the setup walkthrough or `occ openregister:descriptors:list --app=humaniq --import=<slug>`.

humaniq.title: Humaniq Register (demo)
humaniq.description: Demo data for Humaniq Register. Generated from the register's own schemas — see hydra-gates/scripts/lib/generate_mock_register.py.

Administration.title: Administration
Administration.description: multi-administratie (design.md D2): the accountant multi-client tenant catalog -- ONE row per client administratie. This is the switcher's source list and the topbar/Dashboard indicator's label source; child HR/payroll objects do NOT $ref this schema (ADR-062 rule 7 -- they carry a plain-string copy of `administrationId` instead, D1). `administrationId` is the stable business key already used fleet-wide as a plain string on the payroll aggregates (PayrollRun/PayrollMutationReport/PayrollGLPost/PayrollPaymentBatch); this schema is where that key finally becomes a real, addressable catalog entry.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The short code every other record uses to say it belongs to this administration, for example 'ADM-001'. It must be unique.
administrationId.x-notes: The stable business key every other HR/payroll schema's denormalized administrationId property names (REQ-MULTI-001) -- e.g. 'ADM-001'. Unique per administratie; NOT the OpenRegister object id/UUID.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the client administratie (e.g. 'Voorbeeld Accountancy B.V.'). The switcher's option label and the topbar/Dashboard indicator's text.

kvkNumber.title: KvK number
kvkNumber.description: KvK (Chamber of Commerce) number of this administratie, when known.

loonheffingennummer.title: Payroll tax number
loonheffingennummer.description: This administration's payroll tax number, if you know it.
loonheffingennummer.x-notes: Loonheffingennummer of this administratie, when known -- distinct from `SettingsService::getDocumentsEmployerLoonheffingennummer()`, which is the single-tenant instance-wide fallback used before this change existed.

active.title: Active
active.description: Offer this administration in the switcher. An inactive one keeps all its records but can no longer be switched to.
active.x-notes: Whether this administratie is currently selectable in the switcher. An inactive administratie stays in the catalog (its child records keep their administrationId) but is not offered as a switch target.

abpAansluitingsplichtig.title: ABP affiliation required
abpAansluitingsplichtig.description: This administration must affiliate with the ABP pension fund and file its pension payroll there. Set by an administrator.
abpAansluitingsplichtig.x-notes: abp-aansluiting (REQ-ABP-001): whether this client administratie is legally obligated under the Wet Privatisering ABP (1996) to affiliate with ABP and file its pension-bearing payroll there. An admin-set determination only -- humaniq carries no employer-sector taxonomy today, so this is NEVER derived or computed from a sector, function, or CAO field; auto-derivation is a named fast-follow once such a taxonomy exists. Consumed by nl-abp-fund-required (lib/Standards/Checks/NlAbpChecks.php) to scope the completeness check to obligated administraties only.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How this administration is run: an ordinary one with several employees, a single-person company whose director draws a salary, or a sole proprietorship with no payroll at all. Switching back changes nothing about the data.
mode.x-notes: single-person-modes (REQ-SPM-001, ADR-001 Rule 4): the single-person mode-switch on this administratie -- 'ZZP/DGA en eenmanszaak zijn MODES, geen aparte app'. `standard` (default) = an ordinary multi-employee administratie, no menu/page change. `dga_single_person` = a single-person BV whose DGA still draws loon and runs the payroll engine monthly; multi-person surfaces (org-chart, team-approval queues, roster/shift planning) hide, but Salarissen/Medewerkers stay. `eenmanszaak_no_payroll` = a sole proprietorship taking winstuitkering not loon; the multi-person surfaces AND the whole payroll surface (Loonadministratie group + Simuleer loonstrook) hide. Resolved by AdministrationService and stamped into manifest.runtime.user.administrationMode (REQ-SPM-002) so nc-vue's visibleIf primitive gates the menus (REQ-SPM-003/-004). Reversible with no data loss: switching back to `standard` deletes/alters nothing. A drift lamp (nl-single-person-mode-employee-count) flags a dga_single_person administratie whose active-employee headcount is not exactly one DGA, but never blocks a write.

AdministrationAccess.title: Administration access
AdministrationAccess.description: multi-administratie (design.md D2/D7): the accountant multi-client access model -- ONE membership row binding a Nextcloud user to an administratie with a role. An accountant user carries MANY rows (their whole client book); a single-company HR/employee user carries one. This is the closed set `AdministrationController::setActive` resolves the caller against (D4) and the switcher may offer (D5) -- a user can never activate an administratie with no row here. A plain declarative OpenRegister object (ADR-001 data-layer: domain data lives in the register), deliberately NOT a Nextcloud group -- an accountant's client book is app data, not an instance-admin concern.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The Nextcloud account being given access.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id (plain string, the app's existing userId/managerUserId link convention -- never a $ref, it names an account, not an Employee object).

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The administration this row grants access to.
administrationId.x-notes: The Administration.administrationId business key this row grants access to. NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the same convention every child schema's denormalized administrationId follows).

role.title: Role
role.description: How this person relates to the administration: an accountant with several clients, HR at their own employer, or an employee looking at their own records.
role.x-notes: The caller's role on this administratie. `accountant`: one of potentially many client administraties on the caller's book. `hr`: the caller's single employer administratie. `employee`: the caller's own administratie, mirroring the app's existing @me self-service scope. Purely descriptive in the MVP -- the setter/switcher only check ROW PRESENCE, not this value (design.md D7); role-differentiated authorization is a named post-MVP fast-follow.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: A candidate's application (sollicitatie) against a Vacancy. Candidate PII (name/email/phone/CV/motivation) lives DIRECTLY on this object — there is deliberately no separate Candidate entity in the MVP (AVG data-minimisation, design D2): one object carries one retention clock (retentionExpiryDate) and one deletion (deleting the Application deletes the candidate's data atomically). The declarative pipeline lifecycle runs nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, with afwijzen reachable from every active stage. Rejecting an application stamps rejectedDate and derives retentionExpiryDate per the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn (4 weeks, or 1 year with explicit talentPoolOptIn consent) — enforced by the nl-ats-retentie-derivatie and nl-ats-retentie-verlopen checks (lib/Standards/Checks/NlAtsChecks.php, lib/Standards/rules/privacy.json). aannemen documents a MANUAL onboarding hand-off (creating the Employee from this data is a manual follow-up action in the MVP — no cross-object write hook).

uitnodigen.description: The candidate is invited for an interview. No calendar/scheduling integration in the MVP.

aanbieden.description: An offer is extended to the candidate. No offer-letter generation/e-signature in the MVP.

aannemen.description: The candidate is hired. Terminal. Onboarding hand-off is a MANUAL follow-up action in the MVP — HR creates the Employee/Onboarding case by hand from this application's data (the same deferral class as leave-balance auto-posting); no cross-object write hook fires here.

afwijzen.description: The candidate is rejected (or, absent a public career page and candidate actor, a withdrawal is also recorded this way by HR). Terminal. rejectedDate and retentionExpiryDate are stamped on the carrying write: retentionExpiryDate = rejectedDate + 4 weeks, or + 1 year with talentPoolOptIn consent (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn).

vacancyId.title: Vacancy
vacancyId.description: The vacancy this application is for.
vacancyId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Vacancy this application is for.

candidateName.title: Candidate name
candidateName.description: The candidate's full name. Their personal data lives only on this record — deleting it deletes the data.
candidateName.x-notes: Full name of the candidate. Candidate PII lives on this object only (design D2) — deleting the Application deletes this data.

cvFile.title: CV file
cvFile.x-notes: Reference (Nextcloud Files path or OpenRegister file id) to the uploaded CV, the Expense.receiptFile pattern.

motivation.title: Motivation
motivation.description: The candidate's motivation or cover letter.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this application has got to: new, screening, interview, offer or hired. It can be rejected at any active stage.
status.x-notes: Pipeline status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, afwijzen reachable from every active stage).

rejectedDate.title: Rejected date
rejectedDate.description: When the application was rejected. Empty unless it was.
rejectedDate.x-notes: Date the application was rejected, stamped on the afwijzen carrying write. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

talentPoolOptIn.title: Talent pool opt-in
talentPoolOptIn.description: The candidate agreed to be kept on file longer. This extends retention from four weeks to one year.
talentPoolOptIn.x-notes: Explicit candidate consent to extended talent-pool retention. Extends the retentionExpiryDate derivation from 4 weeks to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens maximum of 1 year.

retentionExpiryDate.title: Retention expiry date
retentionExpiryDate.description: When this application must be deleted: four weeks after rejection, or a year with the candidate's consent.
retentionExpiryDate.x-notes: Stored-but-rule-checked AVG retention deadline (design D4): rejectedDate + 4 weeks without talentPoolOptIn, or + 1 year with it (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn, AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e). Checked by nl-ats-retentie-derivatie / nl-ats-retentie-verlopen. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this application belongs to. Normally taken from the vacancy.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Application is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an Application has no employee (the candidate is not yet hired), so this is set from the vacancy's administratie when known, and nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

offerLetterFileId.title: Offer letter file id
offerLetterFileId.description: The generated offer letter. Filled in once the letter has been created.
offerLetterFileId.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the Nextcloud file id (File::getId()) of the generated aanbiedingsbrief PDF, stored via OpenRegister's FileService::addFile(). Null until OfferEsignService::requestSignature() successfully stores one.

offerSigningRequestId.title: Offer signing request id
offerSigningRequestId.description: The signing request for the offer letter. Filled in once signing has been started.
offerSigningRequestId.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the docudesk signing-request id returned by SigningService::createRequest(). A plain string, NOT a $ref -- docudesk owns a different register/app than the in-register $ref targets ADR-062 rule 7 governs (the GeneratedDocument.templateRef precedent). Null until a signing request has been created.

offerSigningStatus.title: Offer signing status
offerSigningStatus.description: Where signing the offer letter has got to. Separate from the application status — a signed offer does not move the pipeline on its own.
offerSigningStatus.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the offer letter's e-signature lifecycle state. The first six values are verbatim docudesk SigningService::STATUS_TRANSITIONS states (PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/DECLINED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED); skipped-no-docudesk and failed are this leaf's own duck-typed/failure outcomes. Null means no offer-esign attempt has been made yet. Orthogonal to Application.status -- observing COMPLETED here never advances the pipeline status (REQ-OFFR-006).

Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A company-owned item issued to employees (laptop, phone, vehicle, tool, accessPass, clothing, other): identity fields (serialNumber, licencePlate for vehicles), acquisition fields, and a guarded custody state machine (asset-management-mvp). A vehicle Asset additionally carries the fiscal facts (listPrice, fuelType, companyCarTaxCategory) the monthly bijtelling privegebruik auto calculation needs (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired Vehicle schema) -- required exactly when category is vehicle, enforced by the corpus rule nl-asset-voertuig-fiscale-velden-compleet (a schema-level conditional cannot express this: Schema::getSchemaObject() never emits allOf/if/then to the validator, design.md D2). No AssetHistoryEntry: OpenRegister's object audit trail already records every mutation.

issue.description: The asset is handed to an employee (recorded by an AssetAssignment with a matching issuedOn).

checkIn.description: The asset is returned and awaiting check. Deliberately the only exit from issued -- an issued asset must be checked in (or its loss recorded here) before it can be written off.

release.description: Checked and back in stock, re-issuable via issue.

writeOff.description: Written off. Terminal. Not reachable from issued by design (design.md D1).

category.title: Category
category.description: What kind of asset this is.
category.x-notes: Kind of asset. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Serial number. Leave empty for items that do not have one, such as clothing or a pass.
serialNumber.x-notes: Serial number; null for uncoded items (clothing, accessPass).

licencePlate.title: Licence plate
licencePlate.description: Licence plate, for a vehicle. The tax details live in the catalogue value and tax category below.
licencePlate.x-notes: Dutch licence plate -- meaningful for category vehicle. Carries no fiscal semantics by itself; the fiscal facts live in listPrice/fuelType/companyCarTaxCategory below.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this asset is: available, issued, checked in, or written off.
status.x-notes: Custody lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (available -> issued -> checkedIn -> available, or available/checkedIn -> writtenOff, terminal).

active.title: Active
active.description: Show this asset in the lists. Separate from whether it is currently issued.
active.x-notes: Administrative visibility toggle (the OrgUnit convention), distinct from the custody lifecycle.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this asset belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Asset is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an Asset has no single owning employee, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema. Maintained by HR/back-office; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

listPrice.title: List price
listPrice.description: The catalogue value in euros — the basis for the monthly company-car addition. Only for a vehicle.
listPrice.x-notes: The fiscal catalog value in EUR -- the base the monthly bijtelling percentage is applied against (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired Vehicle.cataloguswaarde). Meaningful only for category vehicle; null on every other category. Its completeness when category is vehicle is enforced by the corpus rule nl-asset-voertuig-fiscale-velden-compleet, not by a schema-level required (design.md D2).

fuelType.title: Fuel type
fuelType.description: The fuel type. It does not by itself set the tax rate; the tax category below does. Only for a vehicle.
fuelType.x-notes: Descriptive fuel type. Does not by itself select the bijtelling rate -- companyCarTaxCategory does. Meaningful only for category vehicle. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

companyCarTaxCategory.title: Company car tax category
companyCarTaxCategory.description: Which company-car tax rate applies: the standard rate over the full catalogue value, or the reduced electric rate up to the cap with the standard rate above it.
companyCarTaxCategory.x-notes: The fiscal classification selecting which nl-{year}.json bijtellingPrivegebruikAuto rate/cap row applies: standard = the flat standardPercent rate over the full listPrice; evReducedCapped = the reduced evReducedPercent rate up to evReducedCataloguswaardeCap, standardPercent on the excess (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3). Meaningful only for category vehicle. Enum append-only -- the hydrogen/fully-solar uncapped rate and grijs-kenteken/bestelauto regimes are named non-goals, not modelled by an enum value here yet.

AssetAssignment.title: Asset assignment
AssetAssignment.description: An effective-dated custody assignment of one Asset to one Employee (the OrgAssignment pattern, hr-org.json): issuedOn required, returnedOn nullable = the asset is still out. For a vehicle Asset this is also the private-use holding period the bijtelling calculation resolves (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired CarAssignment schema) -- employeeContribution is the employee's own monthly contribution for private use, meaningless (and harmlessly defaulted to 0) on a non-vehicle assignment. No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain effective-dated record, no workflow. Consistency (coherent dates, the asset in status issued while the assignment is open) is enforced by nl-asset-assignment-consistency (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json / lib/Standards/Checks/NlAssetChecks.php), not by a write-time guard.

assetId.title: Asset
assetId.x-notes: UUID reference to the issued Asset.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the receiving Employee.

issuedOn.title: Issued on
issuedOn.description: When the asset was handed out.
issuedOn.x-notes: Issued on (effective-dating per the OrgAssignment pattern).

returnedOn.title: Returned on
returnedOn.description: When the asset came back. Leave empty while it is still out; it cannot be before the issue date.
returnedOn.x-notes: Returned on; null while the asset is out. Must be on/after issuedOn when present (nl-asset-assignment-consistency).

issueReceiptSigned.title: Issue receipt signed
issueReceiptSigned.description: Whether a signed issue receipt is on file (the document itself lives in AssetDetail's Files widget).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything worth noting — the condition when it was handed out or returned.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this assignment belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this AssetAssignment is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring the receiving employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

employeeContribution.title: Employee contribution
employeeContribution.description: What the employee pays each month for private use of a company car. Subtracted from the addition, never below zero.
employeeContribution.x-notes: The employee's own monthly contribution (EUR) for private use of a company car (Wet LB 1964 art. 13bis lid 5; hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired CarAssignment.eigenBijdrage). Subtracted from the computed monthly bijtelling, floored at zero -- never a negative bijtelling (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3). Meaningless -- and harmless at its default 0 -- for any non-vehicle assignment.

AttendanceRecord.title: Attendance record
AttendanceRecord.description: One clock day per employee (klokregistratie): raw clockIn/clockOut timestamps, a break duration, and the working day they belong to. Feeds the three Arbeidstijdenwet checks (nl-arbeidstijdenwet, lib/Standards/rules/labour.json) via NlAttendanceChecks and the RuleAuditService attendance context. AttendanceRecord is raw clock data; Timesheet (hr-timesheet.json) remains the per-period approved-hours record — aggregating attendance into a timesheet is a documented follow-up (time-attendance-mvp design D5), not automated here. No approval states on this schema; the open<->gesloten lifecycle only tracks whether the day is still being clocked or is complete.

sluiten.description: The employee closes the day once clocked out. The carrying write supplies clockOut and workedHours (writer-maintained, not a declarative calculation — see workedHours description).

heropenen.description: Reopen a closed day for correction. Edits stay visible in the audit trail (the SickLeaveCase heropenen precedent).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the employee this clock day belongs to.

date.title: Date
date.description: The working day this belongs to. For a night shift, this stays the day it started.
date.x-notes: The working day this record belongs to (ISO 8601 date), including for a night shift whose clockOut falls after midnight — the working-day key stays this record's date.

clockIn.title: Clock in
clockIn.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee started work (the fleet's submittedAt timestamp convention).

clockOut.title: Clock out
clockOut.description: When the employee stopped work. Leave empty while the day is still running.
clockOut.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee stopped work; null while the day is still open. The nl-atw-max-werkdag and nl-atw-pauze checks pass vacuously while this is null (shift length not decidable yet).

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: Total unpaid break taken during the shift, in minutes.
breakMinutes.x-notes: Total unpaid break minutes taken during the shift. Input to the nl-atw-pauze check (Arbeidstijdenwet art. 5:4 lid 1 break tiers).

workedHours.title: Worked hours
workedHours.description: Hours actually worked: clock-out minus clock-in, less the break.
workedHours.x-notes: Stored, writer-maintained number: (clockOut minus clockIn) in hours, minus breakMinutes/60, rounded to 2 decimals. NOT a declarative x-openregister-calculations field — that operator vocabulary is prop/+/- over numeric properties only and cannot express a date-time subtraction. Presentation/aggregation convenience only: the Arbeidstijdenwet compliance checks always compute from the raw clockIn/clockOut/breakMinutes fields, never from this value, so a stale or hand-edited workedHours can neither mask nor fabricate a violation.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the day was worked. Plain metadata — no GPS/geofence tracking (deferred, own AVG/consent spec).

userId.title: User
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this record belongs to, so it appears under the employee's own attendance.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this record belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service pattern) — a plain NC-user-id string, a copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, never a $ref relation, mirroring the Timesheet.userId description verbatim. Drives the MijnAanwezigheid @me self-service page.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the clocked day is still open or has been closed. Approving the hours happens on the timesheet, not here.
status.x-notes: Clock-day lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (open <-> gesloten). No approval states here — approval of worked hours lives on Timesheet.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this record belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this AttendanceRecord is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

BhvCertificering.title: BHV certification
BhvCertificering.description: A bedrijfshulpverlening (BHV) related certification held by one employee: a plain dated fact (certificate obtained, certificate valid until), not a workflow. A renewal after a herhalingscursus is recorded as a NEW BhvCertificering object with a later certificaatBehaaldOp/certificaatGeldigTot pair -- the original record is left unmodified (bhv-organisatie design.md D4). No x-openregister-lifecycle. Certificate-expiry signalling reuses the existing hr-signals mechanism (nl-bhv-certificaat-verloopt, lib/Standards/Checks/NlSignalChecks.php) rather than a new alerting mechanism, and this schema/its pages assert NO numeric BHV-coverage ratio -- Arbeidsomstandighedenwet art. 15 sets a qualitative, RI&E-driven adequacy standard, not a fixed number (bhv-organisatie proposal.md Why).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee holding this BHV-related certification.

rol.title: Role
rol.description: Which emergency-response role this certification covers.
rol.x-notes: The BHV-related role this certification covers. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

certificaatGeldigTot.title: Certificate valid until
certificaatGeldigTot.description: When the certificate expires. You are warned 90 days before.
certificaatGeldigTot.x-notes: Date the certification expires (ISO 8601) -- the expiry-alert anchor read by nl-bhv-certificaat-verloopt (lib/Standards/Checks/NlSignalChecks.php, framework hr-signals, parameters.windowDays=90).

opleider.title: Training provider
opleider.description: Name of the training provider (opleidingsinstituut) that issued the certification, when known.

orgUnitId.title: Organisational unit
orgUnitId.description: The team or department this certification counts towards for coverage.
orgUnitId.x-notes: UUID reference to the OrgUnit this certification's coverage is grouped/visible under (the coverage-visibility scoping concept, bhv-organisatie design.md D3 -- deliberately NOT a physical Location, which humaniq's register does not model). Null when the certification is not scoped to a specific unit.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this certification belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this BhvCertificering is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); maintained by HR/back-office when the record is created.

Cao.title: Collective labour agreement
Cao.description: A read-only reference projection of one collective labour agreement (collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst) from the maintained CAO corpus (lib/Standards/cao/{caoId}.json), seeded idempotently from CaoRegistry by NlCaoChecks::seedObjects() (cao-library). The corpus is the single authoring source; these objects are a derived display surface for the read-only Caos reference page and MUST NOT be hand-edited (allowCreate:false on the manifest pages). An EmploymentContract references a CAO by its caoId, not by this object's UUID.

caoId.title: CAO id
caoId.description: A short stable id for this agreement, for example 'cao-metaal-techniek'. Contracts refer to it by this id.
caoId.x-notes: The stable corpus id (e.g. cao-metaal-techniek). The natural key the seed upserts on and the value an EmploymentContract.cao references.

version.title: Version
version.description: Which revision of the agreement these figures come from, for example '2025-2026'.
version.x-notes: The CAO revision this projection captures (e.g. '2025-2026').

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: When this version of the agreement took effect.
effectiveDate.x-notes: ISO date the revision took effect.

payScales.title: Pay scales
payScales.description: Minimum monthly pay per scale, in cents. Only enforced once you mark the scales as verified.
payScales.x-notes: Map of schaal -> minimum maandloon in integer cents. Enforced by nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal only when payScalesVerified is true.

payScalesVerified.title: Pay scales verified
payScalesVerified.description: Whether the payScales figures are confirmed against the official CAO-tekst. When false the scales are advisory (placeholder) and raise no mandatory violation.

allowances.title: Allowances
allowances.description: Standard allowances under this agreement, such as a shift allowance. Shown for reference; not yet worked into net pay.
allowances.x-notes: Map of standard CAO allowances (e.g. ploegentoeslag). Display-only in this MVP; not yet computed into net pay.

leaveEntitlement.title: Leave entitlement
leaveEntitlement.description: Statutory and extra holiday days for a full-time employee. Only enforced once you mark the entitlement as verified.
leaveEntitlement.x-notes: Map of vakantiedagenWettelijk + vakantiedagenBovenwettelijk (full-time day counts). Enforced by nl-cao-verlof-minimum only when leaveEntitlementVerified is true.

leaveEntitlementVerified.title: Leave entitlement verified
leaveEntitlementVerified.description: The leave figures have been checked against the official agreement text. Until then they are advisory only.
leaveEntitlementVerified.x-notes: Whether the leaveEntitlement figures are confirmed against the official CAO-tekst. When false the entitlement is advisory (placeholder) and raises no mandatory violation.

workingTime.title: Working time

CompAdjustment.title: Compensation adjustment
CompAdjustment.description: One manager-proposed compensation adjustment for one employee within one CompReviewCycle (comp-cycles), carrying the review-round lifecycle draft → proposed → approved → effective. Separation of duties on approve/reject is enforced by the reused NoSelfApprovalGuard; the approved→effective transition is gated by the read-only, fail-closed CompEffectiveDateGuard. The effective-dated write onto the employee's compensation is a separate imperative step (CompAdjustmentService), never performed by the declarative transition alone.

propose.description: The manager submits the proposed adjustment for approval.

approve.description: A different manager approves the proposal. NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the proposer).

reject.description: The proposal is rejected and returns to draft for revision and re-proposal. NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection.

effectuate.description: The approved adjustment takes effect. CompEffectiveDateGuard fail-closed denies unless effectiveDate is present and on or before today. Read-only guard: the actual grossMonthlySalary write happens imperatively in CompAdjustmentService, not in the guard.

contractId.description: The contract this change is tied to. The new salary itself lands on the employee record, which is what payroll reads.

The effective-dated write itself lands on Employee.grossMonthlySalary — the field the payroll engine reads — not on this contract (verified: EmploymentContract carries only hourlyWage, no monthly-salary field).

CompReviewCycle.description: A periodic compensation-review round (comp-cycles) grouping the per-employee CompAdjustment proposals raised during it. A closed cycle may still hold adjustments in any state (approval/effectuation is per-adjustment, not per-cycle); closing does not force-effectuate anything. CostAdditionPolicy.title: Cost Addition Policy
CostAdditionPolicy.description: An employer cost that applies per worked hour on top of the wage — overhead, workplace, equipment, management fees — scoped to everyone under a given collective labour agreement, to a single contract, or to the whole organisation. The most specific scope wins per cost factor: contract beats CLA beats organisation.
CostAdditionPolicy.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. Deliberately NOT part of the CLA corpus: a collective labour agreement does not state what an employer's overhead is, and that corpus holds only figures transcribed from published CLA texts with a source citation. Scoping BY a CLA is a convenient way to select a group of employees ('everyone under the ICK CLA carries EUR 25/h for rent and management'), not a claim that the CLA says so.

key.title: Cost factor
key.description: A short name for the cost factor, for example 'overhead', 'equipment', 'workplace' or 'overtime'.
key.x-notes: Short stable identifier for the cost factor — e.g. `overhead`, `equipment`, `workplace`. Not an enum: the set is deliberately open, so a new cost factor is data rather than a schema migration.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Who this applies to: everyone in the organisation, everyone under a collective agreement, or one contract only. The most specific one wins.
scope.x-notes: Which population this policy applies to. `organisation` — everyone; `cla` — everyone whose contract names claId; `contract` — one contract only. The most specific scope carrying a given key wins, so a contract-level figure overrides the CLA-wide one for that key without disturbing the others.

contractId.description: Which single contract this covers. Required when the scope is one contract; ignored otherwise.

centsPerHour.title: Fixed amount per hour (cents)

centsPerHour.x-notes: A FIXED per-hour amount in CENTS. The shape most employer overheads actually have — rent and management fees do not scale with an individual's salary. Set this OR percentageOfWage, never both.

percentageOfWage.title: Percentage of the wage base
percentageOfWage.description: An amount per hour as a percentage of the wage — the right shape for a cost that does scale with pay, such as an overtime surcharge. Use this or a fixed amount, never both.
percentageOfWage.x-notes: A RELATIVE per-hour amount, as a percentage of the wage base. Applied to the wage base only, never compounded onto other additions. Set this OR centsPerHour, never both.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Why this amount, in words. For an amount you entered, the justification; for a calculated one, what it was worked out from. An unexplained cost cannot be defended in a statutory submission.

effectiveFrom.title: Effective from

DsrRequest.title: Data subject request
DsrRequest.description: One AVG (GDPR) data-subject-rights request lifecycle record (avg-dsr design.md D7, revised hrmq#99): the requesting subject (employeeId $ref Employee -- the ONLY persisted subject-identifying field, design.md D1 -- the raw bsn value AvgDsrService resolves to call OpenRegister's guarded Gdpr\DataSubjectRequestService is never written here), the right invoked, and the statutory deadline (receivedDate + 1 calendar month, AVG art. 12 lid 3, no extension in this MVP). status is a plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D3/D5): every transition requires a caller-role (admin) check plus, for verwijdering, OpenRegister's own legal-hold/immutable-archival-status guard -- none of which a lifecycle guard's (object, action, userId) contract can express, so AvgDsrService/AvgDsrController/the occ humaniq:avg:* commands own every transition instead. retainedObjectRefs never carries a raw PII value -- only the uuid/reason refs OpenRegister's guarded erase() returns for a held object (hrmq#99).

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The person making the request. This is the only identifying field stored here.
employeeId.x-notes: The requesting data subject (design.md D1) -- the only persisted subject-identifying field; the raw bsn value is resolved transiently, in memory, by AvgDsrService and never written here.

right.title: Right
right.description: The AVG right invoked: inzage (Art 15) / verwijdering (Art 17, vergetelheid) / rectificatie (Art 16) / portabiliteit (Art 20).

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this request has got to: received, in progress, then fulfilled or refused.
status.x-notes: Plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D3/D5). ontvangen -> in_behandeling on a recorded erase preview or a valid export/rectify call; in_behandeling -> voldaan on a successful export, a rectify with a non-null result, or an erase execute whose failed list is empty; in_behandeling -> afgewezen on a rectify failure or an erase execute with a non-empty failed list.

deadlineDate.title: Deadline date
deadlineDate.description: One calendar month after the request came in — the deadline the law sets for answering it.
deadlineDate.x-notes: receivedDate + 1 calendar month (AVG art. 12 lid 3); no multi-month extension in this MVP (named fast-follow).

handledBy.title: Handled by
handledBy.description: The administrator who handled this request.
handledBy.x-notes: Nextcloud uid of the admin who processed this request -- the --as-user/session uid (design.md D3).

completedDate.title: Completed date
completedDate.description: When the request was fulfilled or refused.

outcomeSummary.description: What was done, in plain words. Never contains the personal data itself — only counts and field names.
outcomeSummary.x-notes: Human-readable outcome -- export confirmation, or erase's erased/retained/failed counts, or rectify's changed field NAMES only, never before/after PII values (design.md D6).

Also doubles as the erase-preview-recorded marker: previewErasure() always sets this field (even to an empty JSON array) before eraseSubject() will execute.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Why the request was refused, or which records could not be handled and why. Only filled in on a refusal.
rejectionReason.x-notes: Populated only when status becomes afgewezen -- which objects failed and why, or why a rectification could not be applied.

hourlyCostRateOverrideCents.title: Hourly cost rate override (cents)
hourlyCostRateOverrideCents.description: Employer cost per hour in cents, set by hand instead of the figure derived from payroll. Leave empty — the normal case — to use the derived value.
hourlyCostRateOverrideCents.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. This is an EMPLOYER COST, not a wage: it is not comparable to EmploymentContract.hourlyWage, which is the employee's gross hourly wage and is never used as a cost rate. Integer cents, never a float, so a rate multiplied by logged hours cannot drift (the ActivityCostAllocationSplitter convention).

hourlyCostRateOverrideReason.title: Hourly cost rate override reason
hourlyCostRateOverrideReason.description: Why the derived cost was replaced. Required whenever you set an override — an override with no reason is indistinguishable from a typo six months later.
hourlyCostRateOverrideReason.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. This number reaches a statutory IV3 submission through Shillinq. Free text: the derivation cannot be told 'this employee is seconded and billed at the partner rate', so the reason is the only place that survives.

hourlyCostRateOverrideBy.title: Hourly cost rate override set by
hourlyCostRateOverrideBy.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. Nextcloud user id. A domain-object reference is deliberately NOT used here: this records the human who made an administrative decision, which is a Nextcloud identity, not an Employee record (ADR-046).

hourlyCostRateOverrideAt.title: Hourly cost rate override set at
hourlyCostRateOverrideAt.description: When the override was last changed. An override set before the last salary change is worth reviewing, not an error.
hourlyCostRateOverrideAt.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. ISO 8601 UTC. Read together with the payroll side to tell a stale override from a current one.

hourlyCostAdditions.title: Hourly cost additions
hourlyCostAdditions.description: Employer costs per hour on top of the wage — overhead, equipment, workplace, tooling. Each entry is named and sourced, so a cost figure can be explained line by line.
hourlyCostAdditions.x-notes: ADR-081 decision 4. The hourly cost is `wageCost + sum(additions)`; there is exactly ONE rate, never a normal one and an overtime one. Line-by-line explicability is what an audit asks for, and a new cost factor is data rather than a schema migration. Shillinq is expected to calculate the overhead and equipment additions, because it holds the ledger those pools live in.

key.title: Addition key
key.description: A short name for the cost factor, for example 'overhead', 'equipment', 'workplace' or 'overtime'.
key.x-notes: Not an enum: the set is deliberately open (ADR-081), because a jurisdiction, a sector or an audit will want a fourth.

centsPerHour.title: Fixed amount per hour (cents)
centsPerHour.description: A fixed amount added per hour, in cents — the right shape for a cost that does not scale with pay: rent, a workplace, a laptop, management fees. Use this or a percentage of the wage, never both.
centsPerHour.x-notes: A FIXED amount added per hour, in CENTS — the right shape for a cost that does not scale with the wage: rent, a workplace, a laptop, management fees. Integer so that rate x hours cannot accumulate IEEE-754 drift across a quarter of allocations. Set this OR percentageOfWage, never both.

percentageOfWage.title: Percentage of the wage base

percentageOfWage.x-notes: A RELATIVE amount, as a percentage of the wage base — the right shape for a cost that genuinely scales with pay, such as an overtime surcharge. Applied to the WAGE BASE ONLY, never to the running total: compounding one addition onto another would make the result depend on the order they happen to be listed in. Set this OR centsPerHour, never both.

gebruikelijkloonJustification.x-notes: NL: free-text justification for a below-gebruikelijkloon-norm salary (dga-payroll-mode) -- one of the three statutory grounds (comparable-function salary, highest-paid-employee salary, or a lower amount substantiated to the Belastingdienst). MVP: presence-only exemption from nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm; content is not validated (named follow-up). Only meaningful when isDga is true.

publicSectorRegime.title: Public sector regime
publicSectorRegime.description: The civil-service regime this employee falls under, if any. Leave empty for ordinary private-sector staff.
publicSectorRegime.x-notes: NL: whether this employee is a public-sector ambtenaar and under which legal regime (aor-ambtenarenrecht). A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4), the isDga precedent, never a separate app/schema. 'genormaliseerd' = a Wnra-normalized ambtenaar on an ordinary BW7 arbeidsovereenkomst; 'ambtenarenwet' = still on the Ambtenarenwet 2017 public-law footing (politie, defensie, rechterlijke macht, political office-holders). null = an ordinary private-sector employee, for whom ambtseedAfgelegdOp and nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld carry no compliance meaning. HR-set, never derived from a sector/function taxonomy (none exists in humaniq today); scopes the nl-ambtenaar-eed-vereist and nl-ambtenaar-nevenwerkzaamheden-melding checks.

ambtseedAfgelegdOp.title: Oath of office sworn on
ambtseedAfgelegdOp.description: The date the oath or affirmation of office was taken. Only relevant for civil servants.
ambtseedAfgelegdOp.x-notes: NL: the date the ambtseed/-belofte (oath or affirmation of office) was taken (Ambtenarenwet 2017 art. 5, aor-ambtenarenrecht). Only meaningful when publicSectorRegime is non-null; presence gates the nl-ambtenaar-eed-vereist check (presence-only, the ceremony's content is never validated).

nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.title: Secondary employment reported
nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.description: The employee has declared any side activities that could affect their duties. Only relevant for civil servants.
nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.x-notes: NL: whether the nevenwerkzaamheden integrity-disclosure attestation (disclosure of side activities that could affect proper performance of duty or public trust) is on file (Ambtenarenwet 2017 art. 9, aor-ambtenarenrecht). Only meaningful when publicSectorRegime is non-null; gates the nl-ambtenaar-nevenwerkzaamheden-melding check (presence-only attestation, the disclosed content is never validated).

wntTopfunctionaris.title: WNT senior official
wntTopfunctionaris.description: This employee is a senior official under the Senior Public Sector Executives Act (WNT).
wntTopfunctionaris.x-notes: NL: whether this employee is a topfunctionaris under the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT, BWBR0032249) -- a board member or director who leads the whole (semi-)public organisation. A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4, the isDga precedent), never derived from a function/sector taxonomy (none exists in humaniq today). Gates the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding check via the annual WntDisclosure; carries no compliance meaning when false (wnt-disclosure).

wntUitzonderingReden.title: WNT exemption ground
wntUitzonderingReden.description: Why this senior official may earn above the WNT ceiling. Leave empty when no exemption applies.
wntUitzonderingReden.x-notes: NL: the recorded transitional-exemption ground for a topfunctionaris whose bezoldiging exceeds the WNT-norm -- 'overgangsrecht' (WNT art. 2.7 transitional protection for a contract predating a norm reduction) or 'ontheffing-minister' (a ministerial ontheffing). null = no exemption recorded. Presence-only gate (the ground's substantive correctness is never validated, wnt-disclosure design.md D4); only meaningful when wntTopfunctionaris is true. A non-null value clears the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding check.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: A natural person employed by the organisation. Carries the identity, payroll, and wage-tax attributes the payroll/wage-tax compliance checks read (BSN, tax table colour, ID-document retention, 30%-ruling, A1 posting, minimum-wage basis).

overtimeToeslagPercentages.title: Overtime surcharge percentages (contract override)
overtimeToeslagPercentages.description: Overtime surcharges for this contract, instead of what the collective agreement says. Leave empty — the normal case — to follow the agreement. These are the surcharge, not the total: 50 means 150% of the normal hourly wage. Setting this replaces the agreement's overtime terms in full.
overtimeToeslagPercentages.x-notes: Per-category overwerktoeslag for THIS contract, overriding whatever the CAO says. Null — the normal case — means the CAO's own overtime article applies, resolved through CaoRegistry. Terms are company-wide by default and individual only by exception, so the absence of a value here is the meaningful state, not an unfinished one. Percentages are the SURCHARGE, not the total: 50 means 150% of the normal hourly wage is paid for that hour. When set, the override wins IN FULL rather than merging per category — a partial merge would silently combine two documents' terms and produce a set of rules that exists in neither.

leaveTermsOverrideReason.title: Leave terms override reason

leaveTermsOverrideReason.x-notes: Why this contract departs from the CAO's leave entitlement. REQUIRED whenever leaveEntitlementOverrideDays is set, for the same reason the overtime override needs one.

type.description: The kind of contract. This drives the unemployment-fund rate, and for an apprenticeship how the pay is processed.
type.x-notes: Contract type. 'permanent' (written, indefinite) takes the Awf low tariff; flexible/temporary/agency/minijob take the high tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief). 'bbl' (MBO-BBL leerarbeidsovereenkomst, stagiair-bbl-admin): a BBL-leerling has a real arbeidsovereenkomst and is loonheffingplichtig as an ordinary werknemer (loon, loonheffing, premies, CAO-toepassing all apply), per the Belastingdienst Handboek Loonheffingen (hoofdstuk 17, 'Stagiairs') -- so a bbl contract flows through PayrollCalculator and the NL jurisdiction pack exactly like a permanent/temporary contract, with NO type-specific branch (design.md D1/D2). Takes the Awf high tariff (not permanent). A person on a stageovereenkomst zonder dienstverband (HBO/WO/MBO-BOL) is NOT a bbl contract -- it is a separate Stagiair schema, structurally outside payroll.

writtenContract.description: There is a signed written contract. Required for the low unemployment-fund rate.

Null when no normfunctie is assigned. dpaeFiledBeforeStart.x-notes: FR: whether the Déclaration Préalable À l'Embauche (DPAE) was filed in the 8 days before the hire (fr-dpae).

aanzegdOn.description: The date you told the employee in writing whether a fixed-term contract will continue. Due at least one month before the end date.

administrationId.description: Which administration this contract belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.

bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.title: Placement agreement signed
bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.description: The three-party work-placement agreement has been signed. Tick this by hand once signing is done.
bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.x-notes: NL: for a type: bbl contract (stagiair-bbl-admin), whether the (three-party) BPV-/praktijkleerovereenkomst is signed -- marked manually by HR after paper or externally-handled signing is complete, the writtenContract convention, NOT an automated e-signature flow (offer-esign design.md point 4, design.md D3). The BBL counterpart of Stagiair.bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend. Gates the type: bbl branch of nl-bpv-overeenkomst-vereist: must be true once startDate has passed. Null/absent for every non-bbl contract type (the rule is vacuous for them, design.md D4).

bpvSchoolNaam.description: The school that is party to the work-placement agreement.
bpvSchoolNaam.x-notes: NL: for a type: bbl contract, the name of the onderwijsinstelling (ROC/vakschool) party to the BPV-/praktijkleerovereenkomst. Informational; null/absent for every non-bbl contract type.

uitzendFase.title: Agency phase
uitzendFase.description: The agency phase (A, B or C) of this temporary-work contract. Only for agency contracts; set it by hand.
uitzendFase.x-notes: NL: de ABU/NBBU-fasensysteemfase (A/B/C) van deze uitzendovereenkomst -- alleen zinvol op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency'). Door HR ingevoerd, niet afgeleid uit een gewerkte-weken-telling (uitzend-flexpool D2). Fase A is de flexibele beginfase waarin het uitzendbeding (uitzendbedingVanToepassing) rechtsgeldig kan gelden (BW art. 7:691 lid 2); in fase B/C geldt het uitzendbeding niet meer. Gelezen door nl-uitzendbeding-alleen-fase-a. Null wanneer geen fase is vastgelegd.

uitzendbedingVanToepassing.title: Agency clause applies
uitzendbedingVanToepassing.description: The agency clause applies, so the contract ends by law as soon as the hirer ends the placement. Only possible in phase A.
uitzendbedingVanToepassing.x-notes: NL: of het uitzendbeding (BW art. 7:691 lid 2) op deze uitzendovereenkomst van toepassing is -- het beding dat de uitzendovereenkomst van rechtswege doet eindigen zodra de inlener de terbeschikkingstelling beeindigt. Door HR ingevoerd, alleen zinvol op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency'). Is dit true, dan moet uitzendFase gelijk zijn aan A (nl-uitzendbeding-alleen-fase-a); het beding is juridisch niet houdbaar zodra de kracht fase A voorbij is. Null wanneer niet vastgelegd.

inlenersbeloningReferentie.title: Hirer's pay reference
inlenersbeloningReferentie.description: Note how the hourly wage was matched to what a comparable employee at the hirer would earn.
inlenersbeloningReferentie.x-notes: NL: vrije-tekstverwijzing naar de onderbouwing van het uurloon tegen de inlenersbeloning -- de beloning die een vergelijkbare werknemer in een gelijke functie bij de inlener zou ontvangen (WAADI art. 8). Een audittrail-veld (dezelfde vertrouwensgrens als Loonbeslag.beslagvrijeVoet), geen berekende handhaving: alleen de aanwezigheid wordt getoetst, niet de juistheid van het bedrag. Op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency') met een ingevuld hourlyWage moet dit veld gevuld zijn (nl-inlenersbeloning-onderbouwing-vereist). Null wanneer geen onderbouwing is vastgelegd.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An employee expense-reimbursement claim (onkostendeclaratie / declaratie). An employee submits a claim (amount, category, date, receipt), a manager approves or rejects it, and once approved the amount is reimbursed to the employee. The submit → approve → reimburse lifecycle is owned here in humaniq, the HR/labour app — re-homing the Expenses feature that previously lived in pipelinq. The pipelinq-specific Shillinq accounts-payable sync coupling is intentionally NOT ported: reimbursement here is the HR-side claim workflow; any downstream AP/GL posting is a separate integration concern that OpenConnector/shillinq own.

submit.description: The employee submits the expense claim for manager approval. A rejected claim may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the claim. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the claiming employee); approvedBy and approvedAt are stamped on the carrying write.

reject.description: A manager rejects the claim (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct it and re-submit.

reimburse.description: The approved claim is paid out to the employee; reimbursedAt records the payout date. Terminal.

GeneratedDocument.title: Generated document
GeneratedDocument.description: The humaniq-side record of one attempt to render a standard HR document (arbeidsovereenkomst, aanbiedingsbrief, werkgeversverklaring, getuigschrift, loonstrook, jaaropgaaf) via docudesk's template/rendering engine and store the returned PDF (humaniq-docudesk-documents, extended by payslip-pdf-docudesk). humaniq owns no template or PDF machinery of its own (design.md D1): this schema is a log of the handoff -- which template, for whom, the outcome, and where the file landed -- never the rendering itself. `skipped-no-docudesk` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: a later `occ humaniq:documents:generate` invocation (or the EmploymentContractDetail/PayslipDetail page action) can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one GeneratedDocument per idempotency key may be `pending`/`generated` at a time: the four letter types key on (contractId|employeeId, documentType), loonstrook keys on (payslipId, documentType), jaaropgaaf keys on (jaaropgaafId, documentType) -- enforced by HrDocumentService and audited by the nl-contract-schriftelijk / nl-loonstrook-verplicht corpus rules.

IntegrationAccount.title: Integration account
IntegrationAccount.description: A governance/audit record cataloguing an external system that has been granted access to humaniq's data through OpenRegister's public REST surface (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/objects/{register}/{schema}, authenticated with a Nextcloud app password). This schema is deliberately NOT an authorization mechanism: it records WHICH external systems have been granted HRIS access, for WHAT purpose, and WHEN that access was last reviewed, so HR/security have a single place to answer that question for the REST surface — the same governance discipline humaniq-mcp-adoption established for the LLM tool surface. The actual access grant lives entirely in OpenRegister's own RBAC configuration and the Nextcloud app password, outside this schema and outside any humaniq file (hris-api-public design.md D1/D2). No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain audit record whose status is toggled actief/ingetrokken by an admin, not a guarded workflow.
