name.description: The external system's name (e.g. "Voorbeeld Payroll Partner BV") — the human-readable identity of the integration this record catalogues.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Why this access was granted. Say what the integration does with the data, especially if it reaches records holding sensitive personal data.
purpose.x-notes: Free-text reason the access was granted (the business justification). Any grant reaching beyond the recommended default schema subset (a schema carrying BSN/IBAN/health/special-category data such as Payslip or Employee) is expected to state its explicit justification here, per the hris-api-public README guidance.

nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud user id
nextcloudUserId.description: The account the integration signs in with — normally a service account, not a real employee.
nextcloudUserId.x-notes: The dedicated Nextcloud account (typically a service account, not a real employee) whose app password this integration authenticates with. A plain string per the approvedBy/reviewedBy convention (ADR-062 rule 7), never a $ref — the app password itself is issued and revoked through Nextcloud's own Settings › Personal › Security › App passwords, never by humaniq.

grantedSchemas.title: Granted schemas
grantedSchemas.description: Which record types this integration is meant to reach. A record of intent only: it does not grant or enforce access — the real permissions live in OpenRegister's RBAC settings.
grantedSchemas.x-notes: Informational, audit-only list of the humaniq schema slugs (e.g. "Vacancy", "OrgUnit") this integration is INTENDED to read or write. This field does NOT grant or enforce access — it is purely a record of intent. The actual, enforced access grant is configured through OpenRegister's RBAC mechanism (per-user/per-group ACLs on a register or schema), outside this schema and outside any humaniq file; revoking access requires revoking the RBAC grant and/or the Nextcloud app password, never editing this list. Because it is not synchronised with the real RBAC configuration, it can drift from it (hris-api-public design.md D2 / Risks).

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether this access is still sanctioned or has been withdrawn. Marking it withdrawn records the decision; you still have to revoke the actual access.
status.x-notes: Governance state of the catalog record: actief (the integration is a currently sanctioned grant) or ingetrokken (access was withdrawn). Enum append-only. Setting this to ingetrokken records the withdrawal for audit but changes NOTHING about actual access on its own — the underlying RBAC grant and app password must still be revoked separately (design.md D2).

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed by
reviewedBy.description: Who performed the most recent periodic access review of this integration (plain string, the reviewer's identifier). Null until the first review is recorded.

reviewedAt.title: Reviewed at
reviewedAt.description: When this access was last reviewed. Empty until the first review.
reviewedAt.x-notes: When the most recent periodic access review took place (ISO 8601 date-time). Null until the first review is recorded — the audit answer to "when was this integration's access last checked".

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: When this integration was first registered.
createdAt.x-notes: When this catalog record was first created (ISO 8601 date-time) — the audit trail of when the integration was first registered.

Interview.title: Interview
Interview.description: One interview round (gesprek) scheduled for an Application (interview-scheduling design.md D2). A separate schema, not fields on Application, because a single Application can go through more than one interview round, each with its own lifecycle and calendar identity. InterviewCalendarService projects every scheduled Interview onto one configured shared Nextcloud calendar as a VEVENT (design.md D1/D3); calendarEventUid is the system-managed, stored idempotency marker set on first sync.

voltooien.description: The interview round has taken place. Terminal — the calendar event is kept as history and is no longer touched by the sync (design.md D4).

annuleren.description: The interview round is cancelled. Terminal — the next sync removes the calendar event (design.md D4); the Interview object itself is retained, not deleted.

applicationId.title: Application
applicationId.description: The application this interview belongs to.
applicationId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Application this interview round belongs to.

scheduledStart.title: Scheduled start
scheduledStart.description: When the interview starts. This is what goes in the calendar.
scheduledStart.x-notes: Start of the interview slot. Rendered as the VEVENT DTSTART by InterviewCalendarService.

scheduledEnd.title: Scheduled end
scheduledEnd.description: When the interview ends. This is what goes in the calendar.
scheduledEnd.x-notes: End of the interview slot. Rendered as the VEVENT DTEND by InterviewCalendarService.

interviewers.title: Interviewers
interviewers.description: Who will conduct the interview. Shown as plain text in the calendar item; no invitations are sent.
interviewers.x-notes: Free-text interviewer name(s). Rendered as plain DESCRIPTION text only — never as an ATTENDEE/ORGANIZER property, so no iMIP scheduling mail is ever triggered (design.md D5).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the interview is conducted. Drives how 'location' is interpreted (a room for onsite, a phone number for phone, a call URL for video).

location.title: Location
location.description: The room, or the video-call link when the interview is online.
location.x-notes: Physical location/room, or a video-call URL when mode is 'video'. Rendered as the VEVENT LOCATION property.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this interview has got to: scheduled, completed or cancelled. Rescheduling just changes the times.
status.x-notes: Interview lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (scheduled -> completed/cancelled). Rescheduling is a plain field update to scheduledStart/scheduledEnd, not a status transition.

calendarEventUid.title: Calendar event UID
calendarEventUid.description: Links this interview to its calendar item. Managed automatically — do not edit.
calendarEventUid.x-notes: System-managed, never user-editable. Set by InterviewCalendarService on first successful sync (deterministic value hrmq-interview-{uuid}) and used on every later sync to look up and diff the existing calendar event, so a no-op resync writes nothing (design.md D3). Null means this Interview has never reached the calendar.

Jaaropgaaf.title: Annual statement
Jaaropgaaf.description: The per-employee-per-year annual-statement aggregate (payslip-pdf-docudesk design.md D2): totals derived exclusively from the employee's Payslips for the given year -- never fabricated, never containing figures no Payslip field carries. Created and updated exclusively by HrDocumentService's aggregation step, upserted per (employeeId, year): re-aggregating refreshes an existing object's totals and `aggregatedAt` rather than creating a duplicate. Carries no status/lifecycle -- render state lives on the GeneratedDocument that renders it (D1).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who this annual statement is for.
employeeId.x-notes: Reference to the Employee this annual statement is for.

year.title: Year
year.description: The kalenderjaar this annual statement aggregates.

totalGrossPay.title: Total gross pay
totalGrossPay.description: Total gross pay over the year — the 'loon' line on the annual statement.
totalGrossPay.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.grossPay across the year's payslips (the jaaropgaaf 'loon' column).

totalLoonheffing.title: Total loonheffing
totalLoonheffing.description: Total payroll tax withheld over the year.
totalLoonheffing.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.loonheffing across the year's payslips.

totalNettoPay.title: Total net pay
totalNettoPay.description: Total net pay over the year.
totalNettoPay.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.nettoPay across the year's payslips.

totalZvwWithheld.title: Total Zvw withheld
totalZvwWithheld.description: Total health insurance contribution withheld from the employee over the year. The employer levy is not part of this.
totalZvwWithheld.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.zvw ONLY where zvwMode == 'inhouding' -- the employer levy (werkgeversheffing) is never a werknemersaandeel and is excluded from this sum.

totalPensionContribution.title: Total pension contribution
totalPensionContribution.description: Total pension contribution over the year.
totalPensionContribution.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.pensionContribution across the year's payslips.

totalVakantiegeldReserved.title: Total vakantiegeld reserved
totalVakantiegeldReserved.description: Total holiday allowance set aside over the year — what was reserved, not what was paid out.
totalVakantiegeldReserved.x-notes: Sum of Payslip.vakantiegeldReserved across the year's payslips -- the reservation, not the payout.

payPeriodCount.title: Pay period count
payPeriodCount.description: Number of payslips aggregated into this jaaropgaaf.

verrekendeArbeidskorting.title: Employment tax credit applied
verrekendeArbeidskorting.description: The employment tax credit applied over the year. Stays empty until payroll records it — better empty than a made-up zero.
verrekendeArbeidskorting.x-notes: Statutory jaaropgaaf line for the applied arbeidskorting -- stays null because no Payslip field carries arbeidskorting today (a payroll-core follow-up); never a fabricated 0.00 presented as fact.

loonheffingennummer.title: Payroll tax number
loonheffingennummer.description: The employer's payroll tax number, taken from the settings when this statement was produced.
loonheffingennummer.x-notes: Employer loonheffingennummer, snapshotted from configuration at aggregation time.

aggregatedAt.title: Aggregated at
aggregatedAt.description: When the aggregation last ran -- refreshed on every upsert.

JurisdictionPack.title: Jurisdiction pack
JurisdictionPack.description: An UPLOADED jurisdiction pack (jurisdiction-packs design.md D7). Bundled packs — including NL — live in code under lib/Standards/packs/ and are NEVER imported as objects; this schema is the second home, for packs an admin uploads. Both homes are resolved by the same (jurisdiction, taxYear) key, and bundled wins by default: a pack stored here may only claim a key a bundled pack already owns when an admin explicitly activated it as a recorded override. Activation is recorded on THIS object, never read from the author-supplied document.

packId.title: Pack id
packId.description: The pack's declared id, e.g. nl-2026.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Which country this pack is for. Always stated here — never read from the pack's name.
jurisdiction.x-notes: The pack's DECLARED ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction — never parsed from the pack id. Half of the resolver key.

taxYear.title: Tax year
taxYear.description: The pack's DECLARED tax year — never parsed from the pack id. The other half of the resolver key.

packVersion.title: Pack version
packVersion.description: The pack's version. Every run calculated with it records this, so you can tell later which rules were used.
packVersion.x-notes: Semver. Stamped onto every run this pack computes as engineVersion = {packId}@{packVersion}.

dslVersion.title: DSL version
dslVersion.description: The interpreter contract this pack was written against.

tables.title: Tables corpus
tables.description: The TaxTables id this pack's @table.* references resolve against. The pack references the verified corpus; it never copies it.

active.title: Active
active.description: This pack is in use for its country and tax year. Only set once every validation has passed.
active.x-notes: Whether this pack resolves for its (jurisdiction, taxYear). Set by humaniq only after every validation gate passed — including an in-process dry-run of the pack's own golden vectors.

overridesBundled.title: Overrides a bundled pack
overridesBundled.description: An administrator deliberately activated this pack over the built-in one for the same country and year.
overridesBundled.x-notes: Whether an admin explicitly activated this pack over a bundled pack owning the same key. Overriding the bundled NL pack replaces the engine's regression contract, so it is a deliberate, recorded act — never an accident of upload order.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Any figures in this pack that are placeholders rather than confirmed, so readers know what is a stand-in.
provenance.x-notes: Any verified:false / placeholder:true corpus leaf this pack resolves. Such leaves do NOT block activation, but are stamped so downstream consumers see a stand-in rather than assuming engine truth.

document.title: Pack document
document.description: The pack's full contents as uploaded. Data only — a pack can never contain code.
document.x-notes: The pack's full JSON document, as uploaded. Data only: the DSL has no loops, no recursion and no IO, and a pack can never carry code, a class path or a callable — it names an allow-listed handler or it is rejected.

KeyResult.title: Key Result
KeyResult.description: A single measurable result under exactly one Objective (the KR in OKR): a separate $ref child rather than an array embedded in Objective (design D2, the PerformanceReview -> ReviewCycle parent-child precedent) so each Key Result is independently updatable with its own audit trail and can be listed/updated between reviews. Carries a numeric start/target/current value triple and a writer-maintained progress percentage.

objectiveId.title: Objective
objectiveId.description: The objective this key result belongs to. Required — a key result on its own has no meaning.
objectiveId.x-notes: Reference to the parent Objective this Key Result belongs to. Required: a KeyResult without an objectiveId is meaningless and is rejected by validation.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short description of the key result, for example "NPS score up to 40".
title.x-notes: Short description of the key result, e.g. "NPS-score naar 40".

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the start, target and current values are measured in.
unit.x-notes: The measurement unit of startValue/targetValue/currentValue. Enum append-only.

startValue.title: Start value
startValue.description: The measurable starting value when the Key Result was set.

targetValue.title: Target value
targetValue.description: The measurable value that counts as fully achieved.

currentValue.title: Current value
currentValue.description: The latest measured value, updated between reviews as progress is made.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Progress from 0 to 100, roughly how far the current value has moved from the start value towards the target.
progress.x-notes: Stored, writer/UI-maintained percentage (0-100), conceptually (currentValue - startValue) / (targetValue - startValue) x 100. NOT a declarative x-openregister-calculations field -- that operator vocabulary is prop/+/- over numeric properties only (the hr-leave.json LeaveBalance.remainingHours precedent; the hr-attendance.json workedHours note) and cannot express a division. Presentation/aggregation convenience only: startValue/targetValue/currentValue are always stored so progress can be recomputed at any time and never fabricates the measurable truth. An imperative recompute service is a named fast-follow, not part of this change.

status.title: Status
status.description: This key result's own status, independent of the objective it belongs to.
status.x-notes: The key result's own plain status, independent of the parent Objective's lifecycle. No guarded state machine -- mirrors the embedded goal-status enum of PerformanceReview.goals (the reviews MVP precedent): trivial state, no guarded transitions.

userId.title: User
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this key result belongs to, copied from its objective.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the owning employee, copied from the parent Objective.userId (mijn-hr-self-service convention) -- a plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref relation.

LeaveBalance.title: Leave balance
LeaveBalance.description: Per-employee, per-year, per-leave-type entitlement and usage ledger (verlofsaldo): the statutory plus bovenwettelijk hours granted for a year, the hours used, and a declaratively calculated remaining balance (x-openregister-calculations). Read by the nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum / nl-verlof-saldo-niet-negatief / nl-verlof-vervaltermijn rule checks (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json, leave-verzuim-mvp). usedHours is not yet auto-posted from approved LeaveRequests — that cross-object write hook is a declared follow-up; this MVP records and audits the balance.

remainingHours.title: Remaining hours
remainingHours.description: entitledHours + bovenwettelijkHours − usedHours, evaluated by OpenRegister on save. Declared only here (never as a stored property) so it can never shadow a stored field.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee domain object this leave balance belongs to.

year.title: Year
year.description: Calendar year this leave balance covers.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave this balance tracks: holiday, sick, unpaid, special, care or parental.
leaveType.x-notes: The kind of leave this balance tracks, identical to the LeaveRequest.leaveType value set: holiday (vakantie), sick (ziekteverlof), unpaid (onbetaald verlof), special (bijzonder verlof), care (zorgverlof), parental (ouderschapsverlof).

entitledHours.title: Entitled hours
entitledHours.description: Hours the employee is entitled to this year. Statutory holiday leave is at least four times the weekly working hours.
entitledHours.x-notes: Total hours entitled for the year. For statutory holiday leave the minimum is 4x the contractual weekly working time (BW art. 7:634) — checked by nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum against the contractHoursPerWeek snapshot below.

bovenwettelijkHours.title: Bovenwettelijk hours
bovenwettelijkHours.description: Additional (above-statutory) hours granted by contract/CAO on top of the statutory entitlement.

usedHours.title: Used hours
usedHours.description: Hours of this leave type already taken this year.
usedHours.x-notes: Hours of this leave type used/taken so far in the year. Recorded from approved LeaveRequests; not yet auto-posted (follow-up). Checked against the total entitlement by nl-verlof-saldo-niet-negatief.

contractHoursPerWeek.title: Contract hours per week
contractHoursPerWeek.description: The employee's weekly working hours when this balance was granted, used to check the statutory minimum.
contractHoursPerWeek.x-notes: Snapshot of the employee's contractual weekly working hours at the time this balance was granted. RuleEngine predicates are single-object (no cross-object lookup), so this denormalised snapshot — not a live read of EmploymentContract — drives the nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum check; left null when not decidable, in which case that check passes vacuously. May legitimately diverge from the employee's current contract after a later contract change — by design, the balance was granted under the hours in force at grant time.

expiryDate.title: Expiry date
expiryDate.description: When this year's statutory leave hours lapse — 1 July of the following year.
expiryDate.x-notes: Date the statutory leave hours of this year lapse — 1 July of the following year (BW art. 7:640a). Checked by nl-verlof-vervaltermijn.

lastAccruedPeriod.title: Last accrued period
lastAccruedPeriod.description: The last month leave was accrued onto this balance. Empty for balances entered by hand.
lastAccruedPeriod.x-notes: The last wage period (YYYY-MM) LeaveAccrualJob accrued onto this balance — the idempotency marker (leave-accrual-job). Null on every hand-seeded/legacy row (never touched by the job until its next monthly run). A run whose current period already equals this value is a no-op for this balance, so accrual happens at most once per (employee, year, month) regardless of the TimedJob's fire cadence.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this balance belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this LeaveBalance is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

userId.title: User
userId.description: The account this leave balance belongs to. Kept up to date automatically.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee (mijn-hr-self-service REQ-MHS-002, extended to LeaveBalance by humaniq-personal-dashboard) — a plain NC-user-id string mirroring the approvedBy convention, never a $ref. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas; the MijnHr dashboard's 'Mijn verlofsaldo' widget filters on it with the @me token. Never a form field on any surface. Population custody is LeaveAccrualJob — the schema's sole systematic writer — which stamps it on BOTH its create and its monthly update path (REQ-ACCR-006), so a balance created before this property existed self-heals on the next accrual run and no dedicated repair step is needed. A balance whose employee has no linked account keeps null and never appears on a Mijn surface (fail-closed, REQ-MHS-002). The buy/sell settlement path mutates usedHours on existing rows and never creates balances, so it neither needs nor gets stamping logic.

LeaveRequest.title: Leave request
LeaveRequest.description: An employee request for leave (verlofaanvraag): a period of holiday, sick, unpaid, special, care or parental leave submitted for manager approval. The request lifecycle (draft → submitted → approved/rejected, with the shared no-self-approval separation-of-duties guard) is fully declarative per ADR-031, mirroring the Timesheet and Expense workflows. Leave is the HR/labour surface the portaliq fleet review flagged as missing in humaniq; external employees create and track these requests through the shared external portal (ADR-046), while approval stays a back-office manager action.

submit.description: The employee submits the leave request for manager approval. A rejected request may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the submitted leave request. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the requesting employee).

reject.description: A manager rejects the submitted leave request (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct the request and re-submit.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: The employee asking for the leave. Someone cannot approve their own request.
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee domain object who requests the leave (the requester) — a domain-object reference, never a Nextcloud user id (ADR-046 A4). Drives the self-approval guard and scopes the portaliq external-employee view.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave: holiday, sick, unpaid, special, care or parental.
leaveType.x-notes: The kind of leave requested, aligned with Dutch HR practice (Wet arbeid en zorg / BW 7): holiday (vakantie), sick (ziekteverlof), unpaid (onbetaald verlof), special (bijzonder verlof), care (zorgverlof), parental (ouderschapsverlof).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.x-notes: First day of the requested leave period (ISO 8601 date).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the leave, inclusive.
endDate.x-notes: Last day of the requested leave period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Optional total number of leave hours requested — for partial-day leave or when the leave balance is administered in hours rather than days.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional free-text motivation for the request (e.g. the occasion for special leave).

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this request has got to: draft, submitted, approved or rejected.
status.x-notes: Approval workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (draft → submitted → approved/rejected).

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: When the employee submitted the request.
submittedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the leave request for approval.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: User ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the leave request. Must differ from the requesting employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.title: Approved at
approvedAt.description: When the request was approved or rejected.
approvedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the leave request, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.

userId.title: User
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this request belongs to, so it appears under the employee's own leave.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this leave request belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service) — a plain NC-user-id string, mirroring the approvedBy convention, never a $ref relation. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried here because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The MijnVerlof self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

managerUserId.title: Manager user id
managerUserId.description: The Nextcloud account of the employee's manager, so the request reaches their approval queue.
managerUserId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee's manager (mss-team-scope) — a plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref relation. A copy of the nextcloudUserId of the manager (OrgUnit.managerId) of the record's employee's active OrgAssignment unit, populated by HR/back-office alongside userId because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The TeamVerlofgoedkeuring team page filters on it with the @me token; audited by nl-mss-manager-consistency.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this request belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this LeaveRequest is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun/managerUserId convention), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

LeaveTransaction.title: Leave transaction
LeaveTransaction.description: An employee request to buy or sell leave hours (IKB-style flexibility, individueel keuzebudget): a declarative draft -> submitted -> approved/rejected -> settled lifecycle (leave-buy-sell), guarded by the reused NoSelfApprovalGuard for separation of duties. A sell may only ever draw down bovenwettelijkHours on the matching LeaveBalance -- never entitledHours/usedHours, so it can never threaten the nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum statutory floor. Settlement (LeaveBuySellSettlementService) writes the balance exactly once and stamps settledAmount, which PayrollRunService.generate() folds into the current run's Payslip.leaveBuySell as an already-computed payroll input, never an engine recompute.

submit.description: The employee submits the buy/sell request for manager approval. A rejected request may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the submitted transaction. LeaveBuySellApprovalGuard delegates to NoSelfApprovalGuard first, then for a sell denies unless the referenced LeaveBalance has sufficient bovenwettelijkHours.

reject.description: A manager rejects the submitted transaction (with a rejectionReason). Only the separation-of-duties check applies -- the statutory check is irrelevant to a rejection.

settle.description: Settlement adjusts LeaveBalance.bovenwettelijkHours and stamps settledAmount. Fail-closed unless settlementPeriod is present and YYYY-MM-shaped; the actual balance write happens in LeaveBuySellSettlementService, never as a bare declarative transition (the CompAdjustmentDetail orphaned-capability precedent).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who is buying or selling the hours.
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee domain object requesting the buy/sell — a domain-object reference, never a Nextcloud user id.

transactionType.title: Transaction type
transactionType.description: Whether the employee is buying (adding, a payroll deduction) or selling (drawing down, a payroll payment) leave hours.

year.title: Year
year.description: The year of the leave balance this settles against.
year.x-notes: Calendar year identifying the target LeaveBalance.year this transaction settles against.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave this concerns. In practice only holiday balances carry hours above the statutory minimum.
leaveType.x-notes: The kind of leave this transaction concerns, identical to the LeaveBalance.leaveType value set — identifies the target LeaveBalance.leaveType. In practice only holiday balances carry meaningful bovenwettelijkHours.

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: How many hours to buy or sell.
hours.x-notes: Number of hours to buy or sell (exclusive of zero in practice).

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: The agreed euro rate per hour for this transaction. Visible before approval, so a reviewer can spot a wrong rate.
hourlyRate.x-notes: The quoted euro rate per hour agreed for this transaction — an MVP caller-supplied input, not derived from the payroll engine (leave-buysell-derived-rate is a named follow-up). Visible on the request before approval so an HR reviewer can catch an obviously wrong rate.

settledAmount.title: Settled amount
settledAmount.description: Hours × hourly rate, worked out once at settlement. Empty until then.
settledAmount.x-notes: round(hours x hourlyRate, 2), computed once by LeaveBuySellSettlementService at settle time (a stored fact, never recomputed by the payroll engine). Null until settled.

settlementPeriod.title: Settlement period
settlementPeriod.description: The wage period (YYYY-MM) this settles into. Required before it can be settled.
settlementPeriod.x-notes: The wage period (YYYY-MM) this transaction settles into. Required (and YYYY-MM-shaped) before the settle transition (LeaveSettlementPeriodGuard); PayrollRunService.generate() folds every settled transaction whose settlementPeriod equals the draft run's period into that employee's Payslip.leaveBuySell.

settlementPayrollRunId.title: Settlement payroll run
settlementPayrollRunId.description: The payroll run for that period, recorded at settlement. Best effort — it never blocks settling.
settlementPayrollRunId.x-notes: The PayrollRun of settlementPeriod, stamped once this transaction is settled (the retro-adjustments PayrollAdjustment.settlementPayrollRunId convention). Not required to exist -- best-effort, never blocks settlement.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this transaction has got to: draft, submitted, approved or rejected, then settled.

submittedAt.title: Submitted at

tijdvakcode.title: Filing period code

tijdvakcode.x-notes: Official Belastingdienst numeric period code (Handboek Loonheffingen LH 210, 2026 edition), matching this filing's period + tijdvak (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode). Maand: one code per calendar month (6010 = January 2026 .. 6120 = December 2026). Vierweken: thirteen four-weekly codes (6710, 6750, 6790, 6830, 6870, 6910, 6950, 6990, 7030, 7070, 7110, 7150, 7190 = periods 1-13). Jaar: 6400. The authoritative table is data, not hard-coded here — see the nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode rule's `parameters` in lib/Standards/rules/payroll.json; it is re-issued annually by the Belastingdienst alongside the Gegevensspecificaties, so a new year is a data-only change.

Loonbeslag.title: Wage garnishment
Loonbeslag.description: A court/deurwaarder-ordered wage garnishment (derdenbeslag): an ongoing order spanning many periods until the claim is satisfied or the order is withdrawn -- a fundamentally different lifecycle from a PayrollAdjustment's one-shot correction (design.md D1). PayrollRunService folds the floor-clamped periodic deduction into Payslip.nettoPay as a fourth current-run post-tax component (loonbeslag), never re-invoking PayrollCalculator. beslagvrijeVoet is a required, HR-entered stored input for the MVP -- computing it per the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet is a named fast-follow (design.md D7). status is a plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D5): the sensitive activate/settle/withdraw transitions require a caller-role (admin/HR) check a lifecycle guard's (object, action, userId) contract cannot express, so LoonbeslagController owns every transition instead.

creditor.title: Creditor
creditor.description: The creditor/deurwaarder name named on the garnishment order.

dossierRef.title: Dossier ref
dossierRef.description: The deurwaarder's dossier/case reference -- the human key an HR user matches against the court order.

orderedAmount.title: Ordered amount
orderedAmount.description: The amount the order says should be deducted each period, before the protected floor is applied.
orderedAmount.x-notes: The periodic deduction amount the order specifies, euro -- the un-clamped figure before the beslagvrije-voet floor is applied (design.md D2).

beslagvrijeVoet.title: Protected earnings floor
beslagvrijeVoet.description: The minimum the employee must keep. Take this figure from the order — the bailiff is required to state it.
beslagvrijeVoet.x-notes: The protected minimum, euro -- a stored HR-entered input for the MVP, trusted as the authoritative figure the deurwaarder is legally required to state on the order (design.md D7). Computing it from income/household composition per the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet is a named fast-follow, not implemented here.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this order stands: draft, active, settled or withdrawn. Each change is a separate, checked action.
status.x-notes: Plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D5): activate (concept -> actief), settle (actief -> voldaan), and withdraw (concept/actief -> ingetrokken) are each a guarded LoonbeslagController endpoint (admin/HR gate BEFORE any RBAC resolve), never a bare lifecycleActions transition.

effectiveFrom.title: Effective from
effectiveFrom.description: First period the deduction may apply.

effectiveTo.title: Effective to
effectiveTo.description: Last period the deduction may apply. Leave empty while it is open-ended.
effectiveTo.x-notes: Last period the deduction may apply, or null while open-ended.

activatedBy.title: Activated by
activatedBy.description: Who checked and activated this garnishment.

settledBy.title: Settled by
settledBy.x-notes: Nextcloud user id of the admin/HR principal who marked this garnishment settled (LoonbeslagController::settle()).

settledAt.title: Settled at
settledAt.description: When this garnishment was marked settled (the claim satisfied).

withdrawnBy.title: Withdrawn by
withdrawnBy.x-notes: Nextcloud user id of the admin/HR principal who withdrew this garnishment (LoonbeslagController::withdraw()).

withdrawnReason.title: Withdrawn reason
withdrawnReason.x-notes: Free-text reason the garnishment was withdrawn, stamped by LoonbeslagController::withdraw().

Normfunctie.title: Reference job
Normfunctie.description: A read-only reference row from the HR21 (VNG-owned municipal functiewaarderingssysteem) normfunctie library, mapping one standard job function to a Cao Gemeenten schaal. Seeded illustrative subset only (allowCreate:false) -- NOT a claimed-complete ~150-function library; the exact HR21 normfunctie catalog was not independently verified from a primary VNG source (proposal.md 'Honesty about verification'). caoSchaal lives in the same key space cao-gemeenten.payScales uses, but this schema does not itself invent or store any schaal figures -- it only records which schaal a normfunctie maps to. An EmploymentContract links to a Normfunctie via normfunctieId, HR-set, never derived.

functiecode.title: Job code
functiecode.description: The stable HR21 normfunctie code (e.g. 'HR21-001'). The natural key a maintainer identifies this normfunctie by.

naam.title: Name
naam.description: The reference job's name, for example 'Senior Beleidsmedewerker'.

functiegroep.title: Job family
functiegroep.description: The HR21 hoofdproces this normfunctie belongs to (e.g. 'Beleid', 'Beheer', 'Management').

caoSchaal.title: Collective agreement scale
caoSchaal.description: The collective agreement scale ('1' to '19') this reference job maps to.
caoSchaal.x-notes: The Cao Gemeenten schaal (numeric key '1'-'19', the same key space cao-gemeenten.payScales uses) this normfunctie maps to. Read against EmploymentContract.caoSchaal by nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie only when caoSchaalVerified is true.

caoSchaalVerified.title: Collective agreement scale verified
caoSchaalVerified.description: The mapping has been checked against an official source. Until then it is advisory and is not enforced.
caoSchaalVerified.x-notes: Whether this normfunctie's caoSchaal mapping is confirmed against a primary HR21/VNG source. When false the mapping is advisory (placeholder) and nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie stays vacuous for any contract assigned to it -- the cao-library payScalesVerified precedent, applied to a classification mapping instead of a rate.

caoSchaalSource.title: Collective agreement scale source
caoSchaalSource.description: Which source confirms this mapping, or why it was marked verified.
caoSchaalSource.x-notes: Human-readable note naming the authority to confirm this mapping against (e.g. 'HR21/VNG functieboek -- not yet independently confirmed'), or explaining why a specific row was flipped to verified for illustrative/demonstration purposes only.

Objective.title: Objective
Objective.description: An owned goal (the O in OKR) tracked measurably across one or more Key Results, on a concept -> actief -> afgesloten lifecycle. New member of the performance-review family (ADR-001 Rule 6): unlike PerformanceReview.goals (a lightweight free-text array frozen inside one jaargesprek dossier, design D2 of performance-reviews-mvp), an Objective is tracked and updated BETWEEN reviews via its KeyResult children and optionally tied to a beoordelingscyclus via cycleId. Owned by either an Employee or an OrgUnit team, selected by ownerType.

activeren.description: Activate the objective. From this point its KeyResults are tracked and updated.

afsluiten.description: Close the objective. uitkomst is stamped on this carrying write. A closed objective is history and is not reopened (the ReviewCycle no-resurrection precedent) -- a correction means a new objective. No guard: authorization on who may close is owned by humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement, not this change.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short description of the objective, e.g. "Verbeter klanttevredenheid in Q3".

ownerType.title: Owner type
ownerType.description: Whether this objective belongs to a person or to a team.
ownerType.x-notes: Which owner relation is authoritative for this objective. Enum append-only.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: The employee who owns this objective. Fill this in when the owner is a person.
employeeId.x-notes: The owning Employee when ownerType is employee. Drives the EmployeeDetail "Doelen & OKR's" row. Nullable: null when ownerType is team.

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: The team that owns this objective. Fill this in when the owner is a team.
orgUnitId.x-notes: The owning OrgUnit (team) when ownerType is team. Nullable: null when ownerType is employee.

cycleId.title: Review cycle
cycleId.description: The review cycle this objective belongs to. Leave empty to run it against a plain period instead.
cycleId.x-notes: Optional reference to the ReviewCycle (beoordelingscyclus) this OKR set is tied to. Nullable: an objective can also run under a plain period label with no formal review cycle.

period.title: Period
period.description: A period label such as '2026-Q1', for an objective not tied to a review cycle.
period.x-notes: Free-text period label (e.g. "2026-Q1") for an objective that is not tied to a formal ReviewCycle. Nullable and meaningful only when cycleId is null.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this objective has got to: draft, active or closed.
status.x-notes: Objective workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

uitkomst.title: Outcome
uitkomst.description: How it ended: achieved, partly achieved or not achieved. Recorded when the objective is closed, separately from its status.
uitkomst.x-notes: The scored outcome, stamped on the carrying write of the afsluiten transition. Kept SEPARATE from the lifecycle status, exactly as PerformanceReview.rating is kept separate from its status, so "how it ended" and "where it is in the flow" never collide. Nullable: a concept/actief objective legitimately has no outcome yet.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Progress from 0 to 100, the average across this objective's key results.
progress.x-notes: Stored, writer/UI-maintained percentage (0-100): the rollup average of this objective's KeyResults' progress. NOT a declarative x-openregister-calculations field -- that operator vocabulary is prop/+/- over numeric properties of the same object only (the hr-leave.json LeaveBalance.remainingHours precedent; the hr-attendance.json workedHours note) and cannot express a cross-row average over child KeyResults. Presentation/aggregation convenience only: the measurable truth lives on each KeyResult's startValue/targetValue/currentValue, so a stale progress can always be recomputed and never fabricates the underlying numbers. An imperative recompute service is a named fast-follow, not part of this change.

userId.title: User
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this objective belongs to, so it appears under the employee's own goals.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the owning employee (mijn-hr-self-service) -- a plain NC-user-id string, mirroring the Timesheet.userId / PerformanceReview.userId convention, never a $ref relation. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried here because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The MijnDoelen self-service page filters on it with the @me token. Offboarding.title: Offboarding case
Offboarding.description: A deterministic offboarding case (one per departure): the concrete gates for a leaving employee — exit interview held, assets returned, access revoked — and the statutory eindafrekening components (verlofsaldo paid out, vakantiegeld settled, transitievergoeding recorded, getuigschrift provided) as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified five-state declarative lifecycle (offboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/offboarding-wizard draft's 17-state machine and 7 entity schemas: no OffboardingStep/Eindafrekening/EquipmentReturn/ExitInterview/Getuigschrift/RetentionTimer side entities, no eindafrekening computation engine, no UWV WW-melding/pensioenfonds/ZVW submissions, no AVG retention timers, no per-item asset tracking (the parallel asset-management-mvp owns asset data — loose coupling only, design.md D6). The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOffboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes — guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

afronding_plannen.description: lastWorkingDay is confirmed; the exit gesprek, asset return and access revocation are planned (no field gate on this transition).

eindafrekening_gereedmelden.description: The eindafrekening is ready. Checklist gate: verlofsaldoUitbetaald = true when an open leave balance remains (BW 7:641), vakantiegeldAfgerekend = true, transitievergoedingBedrag recorded for dismissal-initiated reasons (BW 7:673) (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard — see humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

afronden.description: The case is closed out. Checklist gate: exitGesprekDone recorded, assetsIngeleverd = true, toegangIngetrokken = true, getuigschriftVerstrekt on request (BW 7:656), Employee.endDate equals lastWorkingDay (BW 7:667) (audit-enforced).

annuleren.description: The departure is withdrawn (opzegging ingetrokken / VSO niet getekend) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this offboarding case concerns.

lastWorkingDay.title: Last working day
lastWorkingDay.x-notes: The employee's last working day; anchor date for the einddatum-consistentie rule (nl-offboarding-einddatum-consistentie, BW 7:667).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the employee is leaving. This decides whether a statutory transition payment is due.
reason.x-notes: The departure reason. Drives transitievergoeding applicability (BW 7:673) — opzegging-werkgever and einde-contract (non-renewal) are dismissal-initiated; opzegging-werknemer, pensioen and overlijden are statutorily exempt; vso severance is negotiated, not statutory.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this case has got to, from announced through to completed. It can be cancelled until it is completed.
status.x-notes: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangekondigd -> afronding_gepland -> eindafrekening_gereed -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

exitGesprekDone.title: Exit interview done
exitGesprekDone.description: When the exit interview was held. Required before the case can be completed.
exitGesprekDone.x-notes: Date the exit interview was held; null while pending. Gates the afronden transition.

assetsIngeleverd.title: Assets returned
assetsIngeleverd.description: Company property has been handed back. Records the outcome only — individual items are tracked separately.
assetsIngeleverd.x-notes: Whether company property was returned. Records the outcome only — per-item tracking is the parallel asset-management-mvp's domain (design.md D6).

toegangIngetrokken.title: Access revoked
toegangIngetrokken.description: Whether Nextcloud/IT access has been revoked. Records the outcome only — OCS automation is a non-goal.

verlofsaldoUitbetaald.title: Leave balance paid out
verlofsaldoUitbetaald.description: The remaining leave balance has been paid out, as the law requires.
verlofsaldoUitbetaald.x-notes: Whether the open leave balance was paid out (BW art. 7:641). Checked cross-object by nl-offboarding-verlofsaldo-uitbetaling against the employee's LeaveBalance rows.

vakantiegeldAfgerekend.title: Holiday allowance settled
vakantiegeldAfgerekend.description: Whether accrued vakantiegeld was settled in the eindafrekening.

transitievergoedingBedrag.title: Transition payment amount
transitievergoedingBedrag.description: The gross statutory transition payment in euros. Required when the employer initiated the departure; leave empty otherwise.
transitievergoedingBedrag.x-notes: Gross statutory transition payment in EUR (BW art. 7:673); required data for dismissal-initiated reasons, null when not applicable. Recorded input, not derived — the formula constants live as parameters on the nl-offboarding-transitievergoeding rule.

getuigschriftVerstrekt.title: Reference letter issued
getuigschriftVerstrekt.description: A reference letter was given to the leaver, as the law requires on request.
getuigschriftVerstrekt.x-notes: Whether the getuigschrift was provided to the leaver (BW art. 7:656; generated via the existing docudesk getuigschrift document type).

Onboarding.title: Onboarding case
Onboarding.description: A deterministic onboarding case (one per hire): the concrete legal gates for a new employee's first week — contract signed, WID identity check, BSN/IBAN validated, IT provisioned, pensioen aangemeld — as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified six-state declarative lifecycle (onboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/onboarding-wizard draft's 13-state machine and 15-step wizard stepper: no OnboardingStep/WIDCheck/BSNValidatie/Reminder side entities, no wizard stepper UI (follow-up nc-vue widget, design.md D6), no BSN elfproef/IBAN modulus-97 validation services, no IT auto-provisioning, no reminder/escalation engine. The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOnboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes — guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

contract_bevestigen.description: The employment contract has been signed. Checklist gate: contractSigned = true (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard — see humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

gegevens_valideren.description: The hire's BSN and IBAN have been checked. Checklist gate: bsnValidated = true AND ibanVerified = true (audit-enforced).

gereed_melden.description: The case is ready for the first workday. Checklist gate: widCheckDone = true (WID check on or before startDate, Wet op de identificatieplicht art. 15 jo. Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f), itProvisioned = true, pensioenAangemeld = true (audit-enforced).

starten.description: startDate has been reached; the proeftijd clock now runs against proeftijdEndDate (BW 7:652).

afronden.description: The proeftijd completed without termination; the onboarding case is closed out.

annuleren.description: The hire is cancelled (no-show, or proeftijd termination) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this onboarding case hires.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The first working day. The identity check and the probation period are both counted from here.

proeftijdEndDate.title: Probation end date

PayrollAdjustment.title: Payroll Adjustment
PayrollAdjustment.description: A terugwerkende kracht (TWK) correction for a SEALED prior-period payslip, modeled as a DELTA -- never a mutation of the original Payslip/PayrollRun (retro-adjustments design.md D1). RetroAdjustmentService recomputes the original period against ITS OWN tax year (same-tax-year MVP -- design.md D2) with the corrected input, diffs recomputed minus stored into the delta* fields, and -- once applied -- the delta is settled as a nabetaling/terugvordering component of the CURRENT run's payslip (Payslip.retroAdjustment), never by reopening the sealed original. Idempotently keyed on (originalPeriod, employeeId, correctionRef) -- re-running the same correction updates this same object in place.

originalPayslipId.x-notes: The SEALED original Payslip the delta was diffed against (recomputed - stored). Read-only reference, resolved by RetroAdjustmentService; feeds the corpus self-check (nl-retro-adjustment-consistency). Never rewritten.

originalPeriod.x-notes: The wage period being corrected, YYYY-MM. The tax year for the recompute is ALWAYS derived from THIS period (nl-{year of originalPeriod}), never the settlement period's or the current year's (same-tax-year MVP).

leaveBuySell.x-notes: Summed net leave buy/sell effect settled into THIS payslip's period -- a payment (positive, sold hours) or a deduction (negative, bought hours) rolled up from every settled LeaveTransaction whose settlementPeriod equals this payslip's period (leave-buy-sell). loonbeslag.title: Wage garnishment

Included in nettoPay, folded AFTER retroAdjustment/leaveBuySell -- the beslagvrije voet protects the employee's actual take-home this period, never an intermediate figure. Null when deductionCents is 0 (no active Loonbeslag covers this period, or the employee already has no headroom above the voet). PayrollCalculator is never invoked for this figure -- entirely post-tax arithmetic in PayrollRunService.

Lets `occ humaniq:payroll:reproduce` re-derive this payslip's figures independent of later Employee/EmploymentContract edits, and is checked for presence/consistency by nl-engine-provenance-complete.

PensionFiling.title: Pension filing
PensionFiling.description: A UPA (Uniforme Pensioenaangifte) delivery to one sector pension fund for one wage period, reporting an approved PayrollRun (pension-filing-upa-mvp). The APG-administered funds are gated on the referenced payroll run being approved before the filing can progress past review — the verified Loket.nl/APG gating rule — via a declarative create->review->confirm->send lifecycle (concept -> gecontroleerd -> bevestigd -> verzonden) mirroring the loonaangifte filing flow.

controleren.description: Marks the filing as reviewed. PayrollRunApprovedGuard denies the transition unless the referenced PayrollRun's status is approved, posted or paid — an HR admin may still prepare a concept filing while the run is in review, but cannot progress it further until the run is approved.

bevestigen.description: Confirms the reviewed filing for dispatch to the fund.

verzenden.description: Marks the filing as sent. submittedDate and verzondenDoor are stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern).

heropenen.description: Reopens a not-yet-sent filing for correction before it is confirmed or sent.

corrigeren.description: A sent UPA delivery is superseded by a correction. The usual route is a corrected delivery for the same period; this transition's reset-to-concept semantics are a simplified placeholder for that correction workflow.

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: The approved payroll run this filing reports on.
payrollRunId.x-notes: Reference to the approved PayrollRun this UPA delivery reports on. Drives PayrollRunApprovedGuard on the controleren transition and the nl-upa-payrollrun-approved reference-integrity check.

PerformanceReview.title: Performance Review
PerformanceReview.description: A single employee's beoordelingsdossier for one review cycle: rating, sterktes/ontwikkelpunten/afspraken and goals, on a concept -> ingediend -> besproken -> vastgesteld lifecycle with a heropenen correction edge. Under BW 7:669 lid 3 sub d a documented, vastgestelde beoordeling with a rating and concrete afspraken is the precondition for any underperformance dismissal -- this object is that dossier. Goals are recorded INSIDE the review (no separate Goal entity, design D2): they freeze with the dossier under one lifecycle, one audit trail and one retention context.

indienen.description: The reviewer submits the draft verslag.

bespreken.description: The beoordelingsgesprek has taken place. besprokenOp is stamped on the carrying write.

vaststellen.description: The beoordeling is vastgesteld. NoSelfApprovalGuard denies the transition when the acting user equals employeeId -- the employee under review may not vaststellen their own beoordeling. vastgesteldDoor is stamped on the carrying write.

A cycle walks concept -> open -> gesloten; PerformanceReview objects reference an open cycle via cycleId. Deliberately generic (jaargesprek/beoordeling/tussentijds) so a future comp-planning cycle can reference cycles rather than reinvent them (ADR-001 Rule 6).

sluiten.description: Close the cycle. A closed cycle is history and is not reopened (the Vacancy no-resurrection precedent) -- a correction means starting a new cycle.

name.description: Display name of the review cycle, e.g. "Jaargesprekken 2026".

type.description: The kind of review round this cycle covers. Enum is append-only.

status.description: Where this cycle has got to: draft, open or closed.
status.x-notes: Cycle workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

startDate.description: Planned start date of the review cycle.

endDate.description: Planned end date of the review cycle.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this cycle covers.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this ReviewCycle is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Roster.title: Roster
Roster.description: The publishable header for one planning period + scope: the unit of publication for a set of RosterAssignments. Publishing (status concept -> gepubliceerd) freezes the plan and makes it the team's roster; intrekken returns it to concept for edits, with the change visible in the audit trail. A Roster carries no hours of its own — it groups its RosterAssignments (rostering MVP, design D1/D3).

publiceren.description: Freeze the plan and make it the team's roster. Its RosterAssignments join the standing occ humaniq:rules:audit ATW cross-check once published (design D4).

intrekken.description: Return a published roster to concept for correction (the AttendanceRecord heropenen precedent). The change stays visible in the audit trail.

period.title: Period
period.description: The planning period this roster covers: an ISO week (YYYY-Www) or an ISO month (YYYY-MM).

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: Which team this roster covers. Leave empty for an organisation-wide roster.
orgUnitId.x-notes: UUID reference to the OrgUnit this roster is scoped to; null for an org-wide roster.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this roster belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Optional administration/entity code this roster belongs to, matching the PayrollRun.administrationId vocabulary.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this roster has got to: draft or published. Publishing can be undone.
status.x-notes: Roster lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gepubliceerd via publiceren, gepubliceerd -> concept via intrekken).

RosterAssignment.title: Roster assignment
RosterAssignment.description: One employee on one shift on one date within a Roster. Carries the projected planned-clock fields plannedStart/plannedEnd/plannedBreakMinutes, composed from the assignment's date and the referenced Shift's startTime/endTime/breakMinutes at write time (never a live Shift join — design D2), so the Arbeidstijdenwet cross-check (NlRosterChecks) is decidable from the assignment alone, exactly as AttendanceRecord's raw clockIn/clockOut/breakMinutes decide the realised-day checks. A published plan stays stable against a later Shift edit: the projected fields are re-derived only when the assignment itself is re-written. No approval status of its own — the plan's only lifecycle lives on the Roster header.

rosterId.title: Roster
rosterId.description: The roster this assignment belongs to.
rosterId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Roster this assignment belongs to.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the assigned Employee.

shiftId.title: Shift
shiftId.description: Which shift they are assigned to.
shiftId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Shift this assignment projects onto its date.

date.description: The working day this covers. For a night shift, this is the day it starts.

plannedStart.title: Planned start
plannedStart.description: Start of the planned shift, worked out from the date and the shift's start time.
plannedStart.x-notes: Composed from date + the referenced Shift's startTime at write time. Read raw by the ATW checks, never re-derived from a live Shift join (design D2).

plannedEnd.title: Planned end
plannedEnd.description: End of the planned shift. For a night shift this falls on the next day.
plannedEnd.x-notes: Composed from date + the referenced Shift's endTime at write time, rolled to the following calendar day when the shift's endTime is not after its startTime (night shift). plannedBreakMinutes.title: Planned break minutes
plannedBreakMinutes.description: Planned unpaid break, copied from the shift.

effectiveFrom.x-notes: ISO 8601 date this band's figures took effect.

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: A reusable shift definition (klok-vorm template): a name, wall-clock startTime/endTime, a break duration and an optional org-unit scope. Shifts are authored once and reused across many RosterAssignments — the schema carries no dated instance data of its own. A shift whose endTime is not after its startTime denotes a night shift crossing midnight (the AttendanceRecord night-shift convention): an assignment referencing it composes a plannedEnd on the following calendar day (rostering MVP, design D1/D2).

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: The time the shift ends (HH:MM). A time that is not after the start time means the shift runs past midnight.

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: Unpaid break minutes built into this shift. Copied onto every assignment that uses it.
breakMinutes.x-notes: Unpaid break minutes built into this shift. Copied onto plannedBreakMinutes for every assignment referencing this shift (design D2).

orgUnitId.description: Which team this shift belongs to. Leave empty to make it available everywhere.
